reviewItem.question: Does "Added writing a status condition for binding AuthorizationPolicy to a waypoint proxy" mean a change to crd-field:istio|group=security.istio.io|kind=AuthorizationPolicy|path=status.conditions (added)?

proposed.statement: Istio now writes a status condition on AuthorizationPolicy indicating binding to a waypoint proxy; the condition format is experimental and policies with multiple targetRefs get a single condition.
